The '''Lalmy'ash system''' was located in the [[Interior Region]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Archais system/Legends|Archais]] and [[Millinar system/Legends|Millinar systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Lalmy'ash [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of the [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]] known as [[Lalmy'ashian pearl]]s.<ref name="Privateers">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Lalmy'ashian pearl]]s|system=Lalmy'ash [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Lalmy'ash system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
